name.local: ファーストライト・キャピタル株式会社

strategy.thesis: Independent VC investing in SaaS, AI and digital-transformation startups under the explicit theme of 'innovation creation in a depopulating society'; rebranded from UB Ventures in November 2024. Publishes the recurring Japan SaaS / vertical-SaaS landscape research.

summary.en: Tokyo independent VC (formerly UB Ventures, rebranded November 2024) investing seed-to-Series-A in SaaS, AI and DX startups, with a thesis centered on Japan's depopulating society. Fund II (2024) is approximately ¥10 billion. Known for its widely-cited vertical-SaaS chaos maps and SaaS annual reports.

summary.en: Tokyo independent VC founded April 2020 by ex-Salesforce Ventures Japan head Shinji Asada, specializing in seed/early-stage B2B SaaS (~80% of capital) plus healthcare and fintech. Fund II (2023) reached ¥17 billion toward a ~¥20 billion target, with ¥100M–¥500M initial checks. Publishes the influential 'Japan SaaS Insights' and vertical-SaaS chaos maps.

Closed Fund III at approximately ¥15.5 billion (2024), bringing total AUM to ¥24 billion across four funds and 62 cumulative portfolio companies. summary.en: Cross-border early-stage VC (Tokyo + Silicon Valley, operating since 2011) focused exclusively on B2B startups — enterprise/vertical SaaS, enterprise AI software, fintech and deeptech — with 90+ enterprise-software investments. Its Japan funds (4th Japan + 3rd Annex) were formed at ~¥36.5 billion; a dedicated seed fund (autumn 2020) writes ¥10M–¥50M checks. Led in Japan by Akira Kurabayashi.
summary.local: 2011年からシリコンバレーと東京を拠点に、B2Bスタートアップ（エンタープライズ/バーティカルSaaS・エンタープライズAI・フィンテック・ディープテック）に特化したアーリーステージVC。エンタープライズソフトウェアで90社超に投資。4号日本ファンド+3号アネックスを約365億円で組成。2020年秋にシードファンドを設立し1社あたり1,000万〜5,000万円を出資。日本代表は倉林陽氏。

Invests seed-to-pre-IPO in Japanese SaaS companies (ARR zero to ¥10B+), backing ~7 companies/year with hands-on recruiting and enablement support; portfolio includes SmartHR.

Launched the US$100M Japan Trailblazer Fund (December 2018); has backed Japanese startups since 2011, including IPO'd SaaS leaders freee and BizReach, with roughly 38 Japanese portfolio companies.

strategy.thesis: Japan's first 'DX × PE' fund: combines private-equity buyouts of mid-/small-cap companies with in-house software and AI specialists who drive digital transformation, building and deploying SaaS/AI capabilities inside portfolio companies rather than pure early-stage SaaS venture bets.

summary.en: Tokyo PE firm (founded March 2021) positioned as Japan's first 'DX × PE' fund, pairing buyouts of mid-/small-cap companies with in-house software/AI specialists to drive digital transformation. Fund I was ~¥31.5 billion; Fund II closed at ¥67 billion (2025). Adjacent to the SaaS/enterprise-software theme via software-enabled value creation rather than venture-stage SaaS investing.
summary.local: 2021年3月設立、東京のPEファーム。日本初の『DX×PE』ファンドを掲げ、中小企業のバイアウトに社内のソフトウェア/AI専門人材を組み合わせDXを推進。1号ファンドは約315億円、2号ファンドは670億円（2025年）で募集完了。ベンチャー段階のSaaS投資ではなくソフトウェア活用による価値向上で本セグメントに隣接。
